text.en:
Casting your Class Ability grants 'Hellion' for 20 seconds. 

Hellion fires <solar/>Scorching projectiles every 1.35 seconds up to a distance of 32 meters, and inflict 30 <solar/>Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius (40 Scorch with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).

Hellion projectiles count as a Grenade Ability and are buffed by, and trigger, grenade-specific effects. However, <solar/>Scorch and <solar/>Ignitions sourced by Hellion itself do not scale.
